probe_context.multiple_comparison_note: Best-spec choice among 13 layer×token specs (×4 L2) inflates apparent BA; treat as exploratory only.

RQ-C1.question: Does a selected residual-stream intervention causally influence answers to cross-modal relational queries?
RQ-C1.null: Mean primary margin change vs no-op is zero (family-level).
RQ-C1.alternative: Mean primary margin change vs no-op is non-zero in the pre-registered direction.
RQ-C1.falsification: CI for mean change includes 0 and is indistinguishable from random_source null.
limitations: Patching does not prove unique circuitry.

RQ-C2.question: Is the effect specific to logical relation information rather than generic disruption?
RQ-C2.null: clean→cf patch effect equals random_source effect.
RQ-C2.alternative: clean→cf effect differs from random_source and unrelated_token controls.
RQ-C2.falsification: Targeted patch not larger than disruption controls.
limitations: Random controls may still be informative if high-norm.

RQ-C3.question: Do middle/late layers differ from early layers?
RQ-C3.alternative: Layer 18/23 effects exceed Layer 3 on primary margin change.
RQ-C3.falsification: No ordered layer trend and early layers equal late.
limitations: Not a uniqueness claim for L18.

RQ-C4.question: Can intervention improve evidence-sufficiency without damaging correct entailed/contradicted?
RQ-C4.null: Fork abstention gain ≤ 0 and/or entailed/contradicted damage ≥ abstention gain.
RQ-C4.alternative: Fork primary metric improves without reducing entailed/contradicted accuracy below pre-registered non-inferiority margin.
RQ-C4.outcome: condition-stratified raw_margin_change and label flip rates
RQ-C4.falsification: Any gain accompanied by equal or larger damage on correct definite answers.

development_family_selection.rule: Use Phase 1F frozen validation families only for confirmatory causal pilot design dry-run; final confirmatory causal eval requires separate sealed list.

interventions.hook_semantics: Replace residual stream row at end of decoder layer ℓ (post-block output) before layer ℓ+1; document in execution plan.
interventions.token_alignment_rule: Patch absolute last position only after verifying both runs have identical prompt_token_length; otherwise abort pair.

statistics.multiple_comparison: BH across layer×direction family if >1 confirmatory contrast
statistics.exploratory_vs_confirmatory: Phase 2A is design; any future run on 9 val families is exploratory; confirmatory needs ≥30 sealed families

stop_conditions: prompt_token_length mismatch between clean and counterfactual
interpretation_boundaries: Activation patching shows causal mediation along tested path, not unique necessity/sufficiency.
Probe decodability is not causal usage.
Do not claim publication novelty from design alone.
